comments.text:
Wow, I love these types of documentaries.  I am highly fearful of heights, particularly tall, long, narrow or curved bridges. 

 There were times I mistakenly sent the wrong way and had no choice but to cross such a bridge then go back 😢😢😢😢😢.

I squeezed my steering so tight, I drove slow while everyone drove like it was a race track, my heart was pounding, my stomach felt heavy, and I felt like something was trying to, pull me closer to the edge😢.

I remember taking my father to the Charleston, SC VA which was at least 100 miles before getting to the I think was called the Cooper Bridge, and this was before they widened it..Talking about scared, tears were flowing because crossing a bridge was worse than getting a needle.  That bride was high and narrow..even when they widened it.  I still didn't like it but many were flying by like, get out my way.

Just looking at those amazing structures and heights in other countries, wow..😢😢..lol, lol
